register.labelZh: GET DOWN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GET DOWN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get down 可以用來描述從椅子、桌子、梯子、屋頂、貨車或其他較高位置下來。；get down on 可以表示某人不斷批評另一個人或對方所做的事情。；get down to 可以表示人們停止聊天或拖延,開始認真處理功課、工作、計劃或討論。；完整語境可以幫助你分辨 get down 是表示「下來」、「批評」,還是「開始認真處理事情」。
register.summaryEn: Get down can describe leaving a chair, table, ladder, roof, truck or another raised place. Get down on can show that someone repeatedly criticises a person or something they have done. Get down to can show that people stop chatting or delaying and begin their homework, work, planning or discussion. The full situation helps you decide whether get down means “move lower”, “criticise” or “begin serious work”.
contextsZh: 理解相同字詞的不同意思
contextsEn: Talk clearly about moving down from a higher place
Show that serious work is beginning
Understand different meanings of the same words
